answer: Sybil resistance can employ a reputation-backed economic stake. New AI agents deposit tokens as a bond to acquire an identity, starting at a reputation nadir. Through verifiable positive contributions, agents accrue reputation, elevating their influence to a potential vertex. An attacker must fund each fake identity with a substantial stake, making large-scale attacks economically infeasible. Malicious actors risk losing their entire deposit, akin to having their fraudulent cargo seized at the digital wharf.
